Thank you for contributing to aqwenator!

<!-- GPU and its memory, driver, CPU, RAM, disk. -->

## What you measured

Anything: it loaded, memory used, tokens per second, a replay run. If you used

-->

## Surprises

<!-- What was slower, faster or more broken than you expected. -->
